description: Per-ligand pH-7.4 net charge and charge class of five methods on DUD-E and PDBbind
row_grain: per-ligand (one row per DUD-E active or PDBbind co-crystal ligand)

columns.name: dataset
columns.description: dude (3,584 DUD-E actives) or pdbbind (192 co-crystal ligands)

columns.name: compound_id
columns.description: compound id of the original ledger tables the join key to the original analysis

columns.name: parent_smiles
columns.description: input structure of the original analysis (the structure every method was run on)

columns.name: q_naive
columns.description: net formal charge of the default state = the ensemble member with the smallest |charge| (original 'single'; pdbbind: the faithful ledger choice)

columns.name: q_dimorphite_dom
columns.description: net charge of the Dimorphite-DL 2.0.2 dominant state, protonate(ph 7.4, precision 0)

columns.name: q_openbabel
columns.description: net charge assigned by OpenBabel 3.1.0 obabel -p 7.4; EMPTY when RDKit cannot sanitise the OpenBabel output (an invalid structure, usually an [O-] with two heavy-atom neighbours; baseline convention)

columns.name: q_openbabel_raw
columns.description: net charge of the OpenBabel output read from the unsanitised structure; equals q_openbabel whenever ob_parse_ok is True; sensitivity only, the charge of an invalid structure is not trusted

columns.name: ob_parse_ok
columns.description: True if RDKit sanitises the OpenBabel output

columns.name: q_enum_popmax
columns.description: net charge of the most populated member of the pH 6.4-8.4 Dimorphite ensemble (independent-site Henderson-Hasselbalch populations, original code)

columns.name: q_ml_pka
columns.description: net charge of the independent-site Henderson-Hasselbalch dominant state built from MolGpKa pKa predictions (empty = MolGpKa failed)

columns.name: class_naive
columns.description: charge class of the naive state (<=-2, -1, 0, zwitterion, +1, >=+2); charge-only when the state's SMILES is unavailable

columns.name: class_dimorphite_dom
columns.description: charge class of the Dimorphite dominant state

columns.name: class_openbabel
columns.description: charge class of the OpenBabel state

columns.name: class_enum_popmax
columns.description: charge class of the most populated ensemble member

columns.name: class_ml_pka
columns.description: charge class of the MolGpKa-based state (zwitterion if the state has a free positive and a free negative charge)

columns.name: dd_state_charges
columns.description: net charges of all Dimorphite states at pH 7.4 (default precision), separated by |

columns.name: dd_plausible_charged
columns.description: True if any Dimorphite state at pH 7.4 is charged (the original '77%' set-type metric)

columns.name: dd_neutral_excluded
columns.description: True if the naive charge is not among the Dimorphite states at pH 7.4 (the original '9%' set-type metric)

columns.name: ml_q0
columns.description: net charge of the MolGpKa input after RDKit uncharging

columns.name: ml_n_base_groups
columns.description: MolGpKa basic groups (after merging N-C-N pairs)

columns.name: ml_n_acid_groups
columns.description: MolGpKa acidic groups (after merging N-C-N pairs)

columns.name: complete_case
columns.description: True if all five methods produced a charge (the Fleiss kappa population)
